role: Red Team Spotlight Visuals, Animations & Guided Tour UX Inquisitor

wave_2_defect_list.description: Animation pop-in and double-ring asymmetry in tour-halo-pulse. Keyframe 0% began with opacity: 0.85, creating an abrupt flicker at the 2.2s repeat wrap. Furthermore, the delayed ring started at inset: -14px vs primary ring at inset: -8px, breaking harmonic concentricity.
wave_2_defect_list.fix: Standardized both rings to identical inset: -6px with a smooth 0% -> 15% opacity ramp (0% opacity: 0, 15% opacity: 0.75, 100% opacity: 0). Added will-change: transform, opacity and transform: translateZ(0) for 60/120fps hardware GPU compositing.

wave_2_defect_list.description: Static transform: translateX(-50%) on .tour-pointer-badge-top was overridden and wiped out by @keyframes tour-pointer-bounce-vertical which only animated translateY, causing the badge to snap off-center horizontally during playback.
wave_2_defect_list.fix: Included translateX(-50%) directly in @keyframes tour-pointer-bounce-vertical, and translateY(-50%) in @keyframes tour-pointer-bounce-horizontal.

wave_2_defect_list.description: Hardcoded cyan colors (#0ea5e9, rgba(14, 165, 233, ...)) conflicted with themes like Sakura (pink/rose), Warm Sand (amber), Emerald (forest green), and Contrast. The backdrop rule only defined [data-theme='dark'], leaving Night, OLED, Ocean, Cyber X-Ray, etc. with slate-900 fallback.
wave_2_defect_list.fix: Introduced CSS variables (--tour-halo-color, --tour-halo-color-bright, --tour-halo-rgb, --tour-halo-glow, --tour-spotlight-backdrop) for all 10 themes in guided-tour.css. Extended PulsingHaloAnchor with colorTheme='auto' default and dynamic theme override support.

wave_2_defect_list.area: Tooltip Arrow Geometry on Side Placements
wave_2_defect_list.description: Side tooltip placements (left/right) had arrow vertical position hardcoded to top: 50% of the tooltip card. When the card was constrained by viewport margins, the arrow pointed at empty space up to 100px away from the actual target center.
wave_2_defect_list.fix: Implemented arrowOffsetYPx calculation in calculateTooltipPlacement: Math.max(18, Math.min(height - 18, Math.round(targetCenterY - top))). CoachMarkTooltip now positions side arrows with laser precision directly at targetCenterY.

wave_2_defect_list.description: .tour-coach-tooltip had overflow: hidden, clipping the protruding diamond arrow that sat at top/bottom/left/right: -7px.
wave_2_defect_list.fix: Set overflow: visible on .tour-coach-tooltip while keeping overflow-y: auto in card body. Added rounded-t-xl to Header and rounded-b-xl to Footer to preserve card corner rounding.

wave_2_defect_list.description: SpotlightOverlay and CoachMarkTooltip read only window.innerWidth/innerHeight and listened solely to window.resize, ignoring visualViewport scaling on Retina displays and pinch-to-zoom gestures.
wave_2_defect_list.fix: Connected window.visualViewport with fallback to innerWidth/innerHeight, listening to both resize and scroll on visualViewport and window with safe unmount cleanup.

wave_2_defect_list.area: Dynamic Target Border Radius in Halo
wave_2_defect_list.description: Circular targets (e.g. 36x36px icon buttons, avatars) showed square 8px pulsing halos around circular spotlight cutouts.
wave_2_defect_list.fix: Added borderRadius prop to PulsingHaloAnchor with automatic detection for square/circular buttons (width === height && width <= 48 -> borderRadius: 9999px).
